summary: Brera Holdings PLC (d/b/a Solmate Infrastructure) reported results of its June 26, 2026 AGM on Form 6-K. All five director nominees were re-elected with 62%-70% support on 71.49% turnout, defeating a vote-no campaign by RBCH Ltd., an affiliate of RockawayX. RBCH, led by Viktor Fischer, had sought board control after the Board rejected Fischer's proposal to sell RockawayX to the Company, which the Board deemed not in shareholders' interest due to inflated valuation. RBCH also filed a derivative lawsuit pre-AGM. The Company views the campaign as a self-interested control attempt. Watch for further litigation or activist escalation.
